steps.name: State the obligation
steps.obligation: {item} is stated as one testable acceptance obligation, not a wish

report_back.proof: the acceptance row for {item} in the spec artifact
report_back.where: the acceptance table of the spec file
report_back.how: read the statement cell back and confirm it is a single testable claim
report_back.when: on requirement synthesis, before any design row derives from it

steps.name: Name the oracle class
steps.obligation: {item} names an oracle class declared in project.yaml, never an ad-hoc check

report_back.where: the acceptance table, oracle class column
report_back.how: match the cell against the taxonomy in project.yaml

steps.name: Name the proof kind
steps.obligation: {item} names the proof kind that will discharge it (test, run, review)

report_back.where: the acceptance table, proof kind column
report_back.how: confirm the named kind is one the harness can produce an evidence pointer for
